payload.body: issue-0035 handed over. Molt: branch issue-0035 at 8927469 on main 1bf2a10 (worktree ~/Devel/prj/Molt-wt/issue-0035). Molt-matts: branch issue-0035 at 0747b42 on main c53a0b9 (worktree ~/Devel/cfg/Molt-matts-wt/issue-0035), adding instances/kovacs/desktop/gsettings with the ten pairs. Verdict on 8927469, clean tree: bats -r test all tests passing under Homebrew bash 5.3 and /bin/bash 3.2; shellcheck -x lib/*.sh liberators/*.sh bin/molt clean; commit gate clean; tests red on the old code; mutation pass all killed; critic-shell's three criticals fixed (set stderr shown even when the set exits 0; get compares stdout only, so a GLib warning beside a value is not drift; the refused and mismatch tests now prove every pair is tried and GTK still links). NOT VERIFIED ON GNOME: the kovacs values are what the old block set, written in gsettings' print form (overlay-key '', panel-main-menu @as [], the media-keys ['']); I could not check them on a GNOME box, so kovacs-sysadm's upgrade proves them, and a print-form mismatch shows as 'did not take: wanted X, got Y'. Deviations: (1) desktop_install tries every pair before failing and still runs GTK and favourites, then fails; a malformed line stops it before anything is set. (2) _desktop_favorites_file and the new _desktop_gsettings_file share _desktop_instance_file. (3) a # only starts a comment at the start of a line; later in a line it is part of the value. (4) a key that cannot be read back is its own error ('could not be read back' with gsettings' words). Left, critic recommendations below the gate: check/verify pass silently when a file is declared but gsettings is absent; a molt_hostname failure reads as 'no gsettings file'; the instance-path build is still repeated across lib/molt.sh, lib/agent.sh, ssh.sh and keys.sh (a molt_instance_file helper is a later thread). Holding; worktrees stay until you confirm both merges.
